_comment: Maps Square retail item names to wholesale catalog SKUs.
The retail export names the same product two different ways: short
point-of-sale names that carry a SKU ('2800', 'D8 Gummies 30CT') and long
WooCommerce names that carry none ('2 oz. Advanced Hemp Flower Extract
(2800mg cannabinoids)'). Between 70% and 94% of rows per year have no SKU,
so name matching is unavoidable -- but it is done from this hand-checked
list, not by similarity scoring, because the catalog is full of near-names
that differ only in strength or formula (Original 450MG vs Advanced 1400MG,
Resolution order in script/rank_retail_sales.py: exclude list, then the
row's own SKU, then by_name, then by_name_and_unit_price. Anything left is
reported as unmapped and still counts toward the denominator -- it is real
demand, just not for a product we currently sell.
Reviewed by the operator; safe to commit (no personal data).
_exclude_why: Shipping, fees, and test rows. Not products. 'Free Shipping' alone is 1,282 units and would otherwise top the retail ranking.
_by_name_and_unit_price_why: Items whose name alone is ambiguous, split on the gross price per unit.
'Delta-8 THC Infused Gummies' with no count suffix is the single largest
retail line (962 units, $44.9k). The sibling rows that DO carry a suffix
price at exactly $60.00 for 30 Count and $20.00 for 10 Count, which is what
these keys are read off -- not guessed from the average.
Prices not listed here stay unmapped rather than being assigned a best fit.
_known_unmapped: Deliberately left unmapped -- real retail sales of things the wholesale
catalog does not carry, so they have no product to rank against:
single-count taffies, 50ct lemon-cream and peanut-butter taffies, 20ct
Delta-8 taffies, 60-count gelcaps, CBG-D8 gummies, vape carts/pods/juice,
the Good Friend Pack and the Gold/Silver/Bronze bundles, the 2x 1/2oz
Supreme two-pack, the 30-count Green Apple gummies, and the Advanced
Also ambiguous and left alone on purpose: 'CBD gummies 10 ct' and 'CBD
gummies 30 ct' (in-store names whose price matches Delta-8 for the 10ct and
Supreme for the 30ct -- the name and the price disagree), and the 12 units
of bare Delta-8 gummies sold at $25.00.
